study type: Retrospective cohort study and machine learning model development
outcome: obvious bleeding (requiring blood transfusion) during cesarean section
cohort: 600 parturients who underwent cesarean section at a hospital between June 2019 and December 2020.
finding: Preoperative Hb, expected operation time, uterine weakness, placenta previa, and ASA grade were identified as important predictors for blood transfusion during cesarean section, with the XGB algorithm showing superior prediction performance; additionally, ASA grade, mode of anesthesia, infusion volume, blood transfusion, and operation time were identified as risk factors for hypothermia during anesthesia recovery after cesarean section.
cross-section timing: During and immediately after cesarean section and anesthesia recovery
